SDPA replaces attention computation, not Q/K/V projections or the output projection. For MultiheadAttention equivalence, preserve projection weights/biases, head reshaping, normalization/residual placement, and scaling: SDPA defaults to 1/√head_dim, so avoid scaling Q twice. Add per-head relative bias after scaling through a floating mask broadcastable to [B,H,L,S]. SDPA boolean True means allowed; MHA boolean True means blocked. Combine relative bias with −∞ at padded keys. MHA already uses optimized SDPA when need_weights=False. [PyTorch MHA documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.nn.modules.activation.MultiheadAttention.html), [SDPA documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/generated/torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention.html).

SDPA applies dropout whenever dropout_p>0, including evaluation; explicitly use dropout_p=p if self.training else 0.0. Match floating-mask dtype to Q/K/V under mixed precision. Backend outputs can differ numerically; the math implementation retains float intermediates for half/bfloat16 inputs. Recommendation: first compare zero-bias outputs and input/parameter gradients against the supplied baseline with dropout disabled, then verify finite, nonzero gradients for learned relative bias. Preserve bidirectional BERT4Rec masking, appended-mask inference, and final nonpadding readout. [SDPA documentation](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/generated/torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention.html).

FlashAttention eligibility depends on installed PyTorch, GPU, dtype, dimensions, masks, dropout and gradient requirements; arbitrary trainable additive bias is not universally supported by fused backends. Force individual backends with sdpa_kernel to expose unsupported configurations, and profile forward plus backward. Dense locality bias alone does not reduce quadratic attention arithmetic; materializing combined masks can require O(BHL²) memory and backend fallback can erase expected speedups. These are integration checks, not verified findings about the host baseline. [PyTorch SDPA tutorial](https://docs.pytorch.org/tutorials/intermediate/scaled_dot_product_attention_tutorial).
